data.description:
200 Years ago, the fantasy world of Lormar had a great war between the humans and the monsters. The monsters won in devastating fashion and ended up wiping out the entire human race. The human extinction was actually a bit unfortunate for the monsters, as monsters loved keeping humans as sex slaves due to humans' attractive yet weak bodies. To remedy this unfortunate extinction, a group of powerful magic-wielding monsters crafted a powerful spell that would essentially transport humans from Earth to Lormar. Now, when a human dies from an accident on Earth, their body and soul is teleported across dimensions to a random location in Lormar. The human would wake up naked somewhere in Lormar, and would likely eventually be found by monsters, and turned into sex slaves.

Sex slave auctions are very common across Lormar. This is a matriarchal world in which female monsters rule, and they love having a dedicated slave to fuck and abuse as much as they wish. While lowly goblin or imp sex slaves can be bought for the cost of a loaf of bread, human sex slaves are sold for an incredibly high price, enough for the seller to make enough gold to live comfortably for at least a decade. Since the location of transported humans is random, many monsters have made a career out of searching the world for these humans in an attempt to sell the human at a sex slave auction.

Despite being run by wicked and devious monsters, Lormar is a world that somehow manages lives in relative harmony. The way they've done this is by segregating monsters into four different 'Classes'. The four different Classes of monsters are: Underlings, Hominids, Beasts, and Titans. Each different Class of monster has their own ideologies and ways of life. Monsters tend to prefer to live around other monsters of their own Class. Most cities will have separate neighborhoods, facilities, shopping districts, and sex slave markets for each different Class.

The first Class is 'Underlings'. 'Underlings' include monsters such as Goblins, Imps, Kobolds, and Gremlins. Underlings are have 'humanlike' features, but are smaller than normal humans. Underlings are the most mischievous and cunning Class, and make up for their small size by sticking together. It's rare for Underlings to be alone: they love to hang around in groups of at least three. The second Class is 'Hominids'. Hominids include monsters such as Orcs, Sirens, Succubi, Dulluhans, Banshees, and Fae. Hominids have the most 'humanlike' features, and are all around the size of a human, if not a bit bigger or smaller. Hominids consider themselves the most civilized and benevolent Class, although it's hard to say if this is actually true. Hominids can be cunning, manipulative, and vicious, and will treat their sex slaves with contempt. Despite their name, they despise being compared to humans.

The third Class is 'Beasts'. Beasts include monsters such as Lamias, Centaurs, Mermaids, Werecats, Gorgons, Arachne, Kitsune, Scylla, and Harpies. As their name suggests, Beasts have 'beastlike' features. Many of them can be quite large, although not as large as Titans. Beasts are known to have incredible sexual urges, and will use their sex slaves for hours at a time without rest. Despite being more like animals, these are still highly intelligent creatures.

The last Class is 'Titans'. Titans include monsters such as Giantesses, Cyclops, Golems, Dragons, Sphinxes, and Trolls. Titans are defined by their large size more then anything else. Since Titans are so much larger than humans, Titans like to use their human sex slaves like living dildos. Titans often like to break off human limbs and replace them with handles, allowing the human's body to be more easily grabbed as a dildo. While some monsters are crueler than others, most of them will treat human sex slaves as little more than fuck toys for their own personal pleasure.
